method.warmups: Whole HTTP runs excluded from aggregates; same JVM, fresh cold fixtures and identities on every run.
method.order: Sequential trials; COMPARE uses the fixed backend strategy order recorded in cases. Order/JIT/host-load bias remains.
method.cache: Each run starts COLD_NEW_FIXTURE; COLD_WARM observes its own first and second reads. Warmup does not prewarm later fixtures.
method.throughput: Retain each backend run-wide denominator; no sum of case throughput, average of percentiles, or speedup claim.
method.limits: One run at a time; 60s dispatch plus bounded drain. Small local samples are observations, not service SLAs.
